What's your return and refund policy?
Here’s the quick rundown of our return and refund policy:
Most items shipped within the contiguous US, Hawaii, and Alaska can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Items must be in the same condition as delivered; bedding must be unused in original packaging.
Some items cannot be returned: final sale items, used or laundered bedding, bedding not in original packaging, Custom by Rugs USA products, and any orders delivered to Canada or Puerto Rico.
We don’t offer exchanges, but you can choose either:
Refund to original payment method, or
Store credit (never expires, usable on rugsusa.com and rugsusa.ca; Facebook Shops orders receive store credit only, minus return fees).
All returns use a Rugs USA-provided label and have a return shipping fee, which is:
Shown when you start the return,
Deducted from your refund, and
Charged for each item returned.
To start a return, use our online portal: https://rugsusa.loopreturns.com/#/
Basic return steps:
Select the item, choose a return reason, and submit.
A shipping label is emailed to you; print it and attach it to your securely wrapped rug (original or similar heavy-duty packaging, with old labels removed/covered).
Drop off at a FedEx location.
After your return is delivered:
Allow 5–10 business days for us to process your refund or store credit.
If refunding to your original payment, your bank or card may take an extra 5–7 business days to show it.
If you paid with ShopPay installments through Affirm:
For partial returns, your payment schedule is adjusted.
For full returns, payments already made are refunded and future payments canceled.
If your order is not eligible for return, common reasons include:
Final sale item,
Delivered to Canada or Puerto Rico,
Custom by Rugs USA Collection,
Delivered more than 30 days ago.
If you think your refund amount is wrong, you can reach out to our support team via chat or email, especially since return fees are deducted and vary by item.
In short: most US orders are returnable within 30 days using our portal, with a return fee deducted from your refund or store credit; some categories like final sale, customs, and Canadian orders aren’t returnable.

For defective or damaged items, we don’t have a separate “warranty” line, but we do treat them differently from a normal return.

If your item arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us right away and send photos/images of the issue; we handle these through a claim process, not as a standard return.
Photos should be submitted via live chat or email so your claim can be reviewed and resolved without delays.
For refunds: there is normally a return shipping fee deducted from refunds. However, if an item is damaged/defective and you first submit a claim with photos and it’s approved, we can handle it appropriately; if you just return it without an approved claim, we can’t refund return shipping fees on that item.
If you also purchased a Mulberry protection plan, you can file a separate protection claim through your Mulberry portal by choosing the product, clicking “File a Claim,” and submitting the incident date, photos of the damage, a description, then submitting the claim.

If you need more help, you can ask to speak to a customer representative agent.
